About Me

I'm currently pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering at Centurion University of Technology and Management (2023–2027), maintaining a CGPA of 8.0/10. My focus is on Data Analytics and Machine Learning, backed by a strong grounding in Data Structures & Algorithms and Object-Oriented Programming.

I enjoy translating complex data into actionable insights and engineering scalable software solutions — from cleaning and exploring datasets to visualizing trends that support real decisions. I'm actively looking to grow into roles in Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and Software Development.
